description: Implement rest day passes (streak shields), emergency unlock Edge Function + premium UI, water goal customization in user profile, and midnight refresh timer for streams. These are user-facing features that enhance the daily experience.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/005_rest_day_passes.sql: Add 'rest_day_passes integer not null default 0' to streaks table. Add 'daily_water_target_ml integer not null default 3000 check (daily_water_target_ml between 500 and 10000)' to users table. Create a function earn_rest_day_pass(p_user_id uuid) that increments rest_day_passes when the pushup streak hits a multiple of 7 (cap at 3 max passes). Create a function use_rest_day_pass(p_user_id uuid) that decrements rest_day_passes if > 0 and marks today as an exempt day (insert a pushup_session with status='verified', rep_count=0, reason='rest_day_pass').
Create supabase/functions/use-rest-day-pass/index.ts: Edge Function that calls use_rest_day_pass for the authenticated user. Validates they have passes available. Returns the remaining passes count.

Create supabase/functions/emergency-unlock/index.ts: Edge Function that handles emergency unlocks. Validates the user hasn't exceeded maxEmergencyUnlocksPerWeek (2), inserts into emergency_unlocks table, grants unlock for 2 hours via blocked_apps_config update, and creates a notification event. Requires a reason string.
Update lib/models/user_model.dart: Add dailyWaterTargetMl field (int, default 3000). Include it in fromMap, toMap, and copyWith.
Update lib/models/streak_model.dart: Add restDayPasses field (int, default 0). Include in fromMap.

Update lib/services/database_service.dart (the renamed service): Add methods useRestDayPass() that calls the edge function, requestEmergencyUnlock(reason) that calls the edge function, and updateWaterTarget(uid, ml) that updates the users table.

Update lib/providers/health_provider.dart: Replace the hardcoded AppConstants.dailyWaterTargetMl with the user's daily_water_target_ml for waterProgress calculation. Add a parameter or pull from UserProvider.
Update lib/utils/constants.dart: Remove or mark dailyWaterTargetMl as the default fallback only.
Update lib/screens/water/water_tracker_screen.dart: Use the user's custom water target instead of AppConstants.dailyWaterTargetMl. Show the customizable target in the UI.

Add water goal customization to lib/screens/settings/settings_screen.dart: Replace the hardcoded '3.0 L' water target display with the actual user target. Add a tap handler that shows a bottom sheet/dialog to adjust the water target (slider from 1L to 6L in 250ml increments).

Create lib/screens/pushup/rest_day_pass_sheet.dart: A premium bottom sheet that shows available rest day passes (with a shield icon), explains how they work (1 earned per 7-day streak), and has a 'Use Pass' button with haptic feedback. Show 'Next pass in X days' progress.

Create lib/screens/pushup/emergency_unlock_sheet.dart: A premium bottom sheet for emergency unlocks. Shows remaining unlocks this week (X/2), requires a reason text field, has a prominent warning about the fine that will be created, and a swipe-to-confirm action. Premium glassmorphism styling.
Update lib/screens/pushup/pushup_screen.dart: Add buttons/cards for 'Rest Day Pass' (shows badge with count) and 'Emergency Unlock' below the main hero section. Only show when apps are locked.

Implement midnight refresh in lib/providers/health_provider.dart: Add a Timer that calculates duration until midnight and resubscribes to streams when midnight arrives. Cancel timer on dispose. This fixes the FIXME comment about streams not updating past midnight.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 005 adds rest_day_passes and daily_water_target_ml columns
Edge functions use-rest-day-pass and emergency-unlock exist and follow the _shared/common.ts patterns
Water target is customizable from settings and reflected in the water tracker
Rest day pass UI shows available passes with premium styling
Emergency unlock has a complete flow (UI + Edge Function)
Midnight refresh timer is implemented in health_provider.dart
verification: Verify migration file 005_rest_day_passes.sql has valid SQL syntax
Verify edge function files exist at supabase/functions/use-rest-day-pass/index.ts and supabase/functions/emergency-unlock/index.ts
Grep for 'dailyWaterTargetMl' in user_model.dart to confirm new field exists
Grep for 'midnight' or 'Timer' in health_provider.dart to confirm refresh logic
findings: DatabaseService is provided in main.dart via Provider<DatabaseService>. Water target sync happens in auth_wrapper.dart when user model loads. The midnight refresh timer reschedules itself recursively on each midnight. Emergency unlock sheet uses BackdropFilter for glassmorphism (requires import dart:ui). AnimatedBuilder is available in Flutter 3.10+. The settings screen water goal sheet uses StatefulBuilder inside showModalBottomSheet for local state management.
